captures.dailyInbox: title, preview, preview description, indexed-match caption
captures.projects: preview/title with ordered multi-selection and live project note text
captures.detail: display title, task label and saved preview

captions: Static comments carry their exact full text independently of capture originals. Truncation does not truncate drag data.
collections: Collapsed summaries and expanded batch/hour metadata carry every saved capture as distinct native items.
intentionalExclusions: Editable fields retain normal editing and selection; selected text uses native text behavior.
Copy, completion, project, menu, collapse and other action controls remain independent.
Recently Deleted captures must be restored before their saved content can be transferred.
externalContract: Text, URL, native saved-file URLs and original encoded image bytes; copy-only external operation, source records and general clipboard unchanged.
physicalDropCompletion: pending manual check; automated source gesture did not reach receiver callbacks
